attributes.name: Lamatar Bayden
attributes.powers:
Lamatar is immune to the Cold, Mental, and Poison traits. If the check to defeat does not have the Magic trait, Lamatar is undefeated.

Before the encounter, Lamatar deals 1d4-1 Cold damage to a character of your choice at this location.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.
